title: Principal Marketing Manager, Retention & Engagement
description_html:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.


Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Principal Marketing Manager to own the strategic vision for how Vivint builds retention and engagement across every customer touchpoint. This is a role for a marketing leader who sees the whole customer journey — not just campaigns — and who's driven to turn that view into bold, new programs that deepen engagement and keep customers with Vivint for years.


You'll audit the current state of Vivint's marketing experiences across all surfaces, identify where the gaps and opportunities are, and set the strategic direction for what comes next. You'll be the person in the room translating brand insight into customer strategy, and the person leadership turns to when the marketing problem is genuinely hard. This role demands someone who can operate autonomously, bring big ideas to the table, hold their ground when challenged — and challenge others right back.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the strategic vision for retention and engagement marketing across the full customer experience — from onboarding through renewal and beyond
  • Audit existing marketing experiences across all surfaces to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and untapped opportunities
  • Design and launch new, innovative retention and engagement programs that increase customer stickiness and lifetime value
  • Translate brand insights into concrete customer strategy, ensuring every experience reinforces why customers chose — and should stay with — Vivint
  • Partner with and influence senior leadership, shaping marketing strategy at the highest levels of the organization
  • Bring a customer-obsessed lens to every decision, constantly asking how initiatives affect the real, lived experience of Vivint customers
  • Operate as a self-starter — identifying problems before they're assigned, and building solutions with minimal oversight
  • Thrive on complexity, seeking out the hardest marketing problems rather than avoiding them

What You'll Bring:

  • A track record as a strategic marketing leader with experience shaping and influencing strategy at the executive level
  • Deep expertise in retention, engagement, and lifecycle marketing, with a portfolio of programs that moved real business metrics
  • A sharp eye for connecting brand insight to customer strategy
  • Strong creative instincts paired with the rigor to execute at scale
  • A customer-obsessed mindset — you default to the customer's point of view in every decision
  • Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, and confidence to challenge ideas (including your own) in pursuit of the best outcome
  • Genuine excitement for solving complex, multi-layered marketing problems

Why Vivint:

Join Vivint at a defining moment — as we integrate with NRG and reimagine what loyalty looks like for millions of smart home customers. This role comes with real influence over strategy, real ownership of the customer journey, and the chance to build retention programs that will shape the company's future.

NRG Energy is committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

Requirements:
Why WWT?
World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe. Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution on capabilities.
With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada. Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!
A Brief Overview:

This team member will have direct access to our senior business leaders to develop strategies and gather content for developing amazing experiences for our partners, customers and employees. The role is equal parts creative, collaborative, and revenue-minded, with the flexibility to slide from setting strategy to executing on the ground with our field sales and team members. In this position, you will work closely with sales and marketing teams to create awareness and demand generation programs to achieve pipeline and revenue goals.

Responsibilities:
  • Deliver exceptional company and customer event experiences, in partnership and in alignment with the vision set by Sales and Marketing Leadership teams
  • Utilizes research, data, and insights to inform the selection of, and strategy for, all events and sponsorships, in alignment with the vision set by Sales and Marketing Leadership teams
  • Event examples include local/regional trade shows, hyper-local customer appreciation events, networking events and large receptions, thought leadership seminars, owned event series, etc.
  • Drives the planning, coordination, documentation and execution of events
  • Demonstrate success in event management and project management
  • Works horizontally with Marketing peers to influence messaging and articulate World Wide Technology's capabilities, differentiating value, and key benefits for the Vertical/Region
  • Creates experiences that engage with customers every step of their journey: pre, during and post event, deepening consideration and intent at every stage
  • Additional multi-channel touchpoints, developed in partnership with Marketing peers, may include digital advertising, website content, email campaigns, OOH, PR, event signage/collateral, social posts, community engagement, lead acquisition, etc.
  • Understand business priorities and identify process improvements to create efficiency
  • Develops and manages relationships with key sales and other marketing stakeholders that are internal clients of the Sales Marketing Team. This may include Sales leadership, Services leadership, Engineering leadership, and other key executives
  • Builds strong relationship with and collaborate with OEMs for the purpose of obtaining funding for campaigns
  • Assist in the planning, coordination, documentation, execution, and purchasing of promotional
    materials, managing requirements with creative services department
  • Develops budgets, forecasts and reports out on budgetary matters
  • Maintain a keen understanding of industry trends affecting clients, and using the trends to make
    strategic recommendations
  • Campaign ROI analysis and reporting
  • 3rd party vendor management
  • Onsite management of sales activities and events
  • Travel as necessary to execute marketing initiatives (Up to 30% travel)

Job Summary

The David Eccles School of Business is seeking an experienced and collaborative Senior Manager, Marketing and Brand Strategy to serve as a strategic marketing partner for assigned programs, departments, centers, institutes, and school-wide initiatives.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Brand Strategy, Marketing, and Communications, this role develops and leads integrated marketing strategies that advance school priorities, strengthen the Eccles brand, and engage key audiences. The Senior Manager will build trusted relationships with internal partners, translate business and program objectives into effective marketing strategies, and lead initiatives from planning through multi-channel execution and measurement.

The ideal candidate is a strategic marketer who combines strong business acumen with hands-on execution. They will bring experience developing audience-focused marketing strategies, shaping messaging and content, collaborating with creative and channel partners, and using performance insights to continually improve results.

Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, communication, writing, relationship management, and organizational skills, as well as the ability to navigate a complex organization, manage multiple priorities, influence across teams, and turn strategy into high-quality, measurable marketing outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the strategic marketing partner for assigned programs, departments, centers, institutes, and school initiatives

  • Develop integrated marketing plans that translate organizational objectives and audience needs into clear strategies, messaging, channels, tactics, and measures of success

  • Build strong relationships with school partners while providing strategic marketing counsel and recommendations

  • Identify marketing opportunities and challenges, define objectives and audiences, and develop strategies, messaging, channels, and tactics to achieve desired outcomes

  • Lead marketing initiatives from planning through execution, coordinating work across multiple marketing channels and collaborating with content, creative, digital, communications, and other marketing colleagues

  • Develop messaging and write marketing copy across channels, including advertising, digital, email, web, social media, presentations, and other marketing materials

  • Provide strategic direction and feedback on creative work, ensuring design, messaging, and execution effectively advance the marketing strategy and meet brand standards

  • Manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously while ensuring quality, accountability, effective communication, and successful execution

  • Ensure marketing and communications initiatives align with the David Eccles School of Business brand, messaging, strategic priorities, and quality standards

  • Monitor marketing performance and recommend improvements based on analytics and organizational goals

  • Collaborate across the Branding, Marketing, and Communications team to strengthen marketing effectiveness, consistency, and continuous improvement

  • Lead and contribute to additional strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT : 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor’s degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).

Senior Manager, Market & Brand Strategy Management: Requires a bachelor’s (or equivalency) + 8 years or a master’s (or equivalency) + 6 years of directly related work experience

Preferences

  • Experience working in higher education or other complex, matrixed organizations

  • Agency experience or experience working with multiple partners, stakeholders, departments, or business units is a plus

  • Significant professional marketing experience with demonstrated strategic responsibility for developing marketing strategies, not solely coordinating or executing marketing projects

  • Experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and audiences

  • Demonstrated ability to translate organizational goals and audience insights into clear marketing strategies and recommendations

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and serve as a strategic advisor to organizational leaders and stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of brand management, messaging, content strategy, creative strategy, digital marketing, and integrated marketing

  • Strong writing and editing skills with demonstrated ability to develop effective marketing copy and messaging

  • Ability to evaluate creative work and provide clear, strategic direction and feedback on design, messaging, and execution

  • Experience using marketing analytics and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and inform decision-making

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organization, communication, and follow-through

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience with Asana or other project management platforms

title: Growth Marketing Director
description_html:
nicity is a health intervention company. We connect people with the products, the app, and the community that together can genuinely change their health — starting with our yerba maté formulated to support fasting and a fibre drink that slows carb absorption at mealtime, brought together in the Feel Great program. Our customers don't just buy a supplement; they start a program that reshapes how they eat, how they feel, and how they live. That means the experience we build — from the first page someone lands on, through checkout, into the app, and across every week after — is what determines whether a customer actually transforms their health or drifts away.

About the Role
We're hiring a Director of Growth to own the entire e-commerce funnel, acquisition and retention - from a customer's first visit through checkout, first-purchase activation, and long-term repeat revenue. You'll lead two initiatives (Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle) and be accountable for how they work as one system rather than two silos handing customers back and forth.

This is a builder-operator role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone with hundreds of reps running structured experiments, who reads a funnel like a P&L, and who has personally shipped the tests, not just approved someone else's roadmap. You'll set the growth strategy and then implement it.

We are in the middle of redefining our tech stack, and you’ll collaborate directly with the Director of Product and Tech Leads to make sure your team has the tools it needs to succeed.

What You'll Own

  • The full funnel, as one number. Conversion, AOV, activation, repeat rate, and customer LTV — one connected model, not a web metric and an email metric that never meet. You'll know exactly where visitors drop off across the entire lifecycle and why.
  • A high-velocity testing program. Build and run the experimentation engine across landing pages, product pages, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle email/SMS. Prioritize by expected impact, ship weekly, and hold the team to a real read on what won and what didn't. Our traffic comes with high built-in intent rather than from paid ads — so tests have to be designed for the volume and audience we actually have.
  • First-purchase acquisition. Maximize the yield of every visit: page experience, offer structure, and first-purchase conversion. Our customers arrive with intent already established, so the job is to convert that intent — not manufacture it.
  • Retention and lifecycle. Oversee our email/SMS team, onboarding, activation into the Feel Great app, re-order, winback, and reactivation. Grow repeat revenue and LTV as deliberately as first-purchase conversion.
  • The promo and launch calendar. Ship the site pages, offers, and lifecycle flows behind product launches and promotions, coordinating timelines across marketing and design.
  • Instrumentation and truth. Own tracking and reporting so the whole company sees the same funnel weekly, and turn it into a visible, prioritized hypothesis backlog. Bring the qualitative "why" — reviews, support tickets, surveys, session replays — because we can't lean on paid-channel data for audience insight.
  • The team. Manage, coach, and raise the bar for the employees on the team (currently 4 people across Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle); hire to fill gaps; set the operating cadence (weekly test reviews, roadmap, reporting).



What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years in growth, CRO, lifecycle, or e-commerce, with 2+ years leading people — ideally at a high-performing DTC or subscription brand.
  • A serious testing track record: you can talk through dozens of specific experiments you designed, the hypotheses, and what you learned when they lost.
  • Full-funnel range — you've owned or worked hands-on across both acquisition/CRO and retention/lifecycle, not just one side.
  • Fluency in the numbers: you build your own analysis, size opportunities before you test them, and understand statistical significance well enough to not fool yourself. SQL a strong plus; GA4/analytics and an experimentation tool (Optimizely, VWO, Convert, or similar) expected.
  • Comfortable in the tools of the funnel — enough HTML/CSS to unblock a test, and hands-on experience with an ESP/lifecycle platform (Iterable, Klaviyo or similar).
  • A leader who stays close to the work — sets direction and still reads the test results line by line.
  • Genuine interest in metabolic health, fasting, or wellness is a plus, not a requirement.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with affiliate-, influencer-, or referral-driven e-commerce (where attribution is different and on-site experience matters more).
  • Shopify or comparable platform depth.
  • Subscription/re-order or app-activation experience — moving people into a connected digital product, not just re-selling a SKU.
  • Experience building a testing culture on a team, not just running tests yourself.

  • Marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot) and analytics tool experience
  • Strong written/verbal communication
  • Cross-team collaboration ability, especially with Sales

title: Solution Campaign Marketing Director – NorAm
description_html:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


This position is a great opportunity for a strategic, creative, and AI-savvy marketer with a proven track record of designing and executing multi-channel enterprise B2B marketing programs that start conversations and drive and accelerate pipeline at scale.

This director owns solution campaign marketing for North American growth accounts— the broad base of prospect and early-stage accounts across FICO's target industries. The mandate is to build interest, awareness, and qualified pipeline across that account universe so that accounts land, generate initial ARR, and earn a place in our Pod-based ABM program. This role is the engine that feeds the Pods, which are responsible for expansion of our FICO® Platform solution across our existing customer accounts.


What You’ll Contribute


  • Serve as the strategic solution campaign marketing lead for all NorAm growth accounts. You’ll set priorities and orchestrate execution, collaborating with FICO’s digital, value messaging team, events, and SDR teams without direct management authority — requiring strong influence and coalition-building skills.
  • Design and execute well-orchestrated, scalable multi-channel campaigns incorporating email, webinars, advertising, tradeshows, and other 1:Many tactics to create awareness and interest across account base and convert it into qualified pipeline. Candidates should be equally strong across both disciplines; and all campaigns will be AI first.
  • Define and run the account journey from first touch to "Pod-ready": build and manage a consistent set of criteria and handoff process, in partnership with sales and Pod leadership, for when a landed account with initial ARR graduates from campaign-based coverage into a Pod for ongoing ABM.
  • Own marketing-sourced pipeline, new-logo, and initial-ARR targets across assigned account base, and manage the allocated marketing budget against those targets.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can be used to generate qualified pipeline beyond content creation at scale — including approaches such as predictive or intent-based lead scoring, AI-driven account prioritization and next-best-action recommendations across a large account universe, and AI-assisted SDR workflows or automation. Hands-on implementation experience is not required, but candidates who can speak credibly to what they’ve tried, what worked, and what didn’t will be strongly preferred, as this person will help shape our broader AI strategy for pipeline generation.
  • Apply scaled, 1:Many and 1:Few campaign strategies across the non-Pod account base —to build pipeline broadly and surface the accounts with the strongest signals for a Pod handoff.
  • Build and maintain a strong partnership with NorAm Sales leadership and Pod leads, and nurture ongoing relationships with account managers, the SDR team, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Develop messaging strategies and content for emails, webinars, and events, collaborating closely with product marketing and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with the events team to plan and execute outstanding tradeshows and customer-specific events (approximately 10–25% travel expected).
  • Identify white-space growth opportunities across the assigned NorAm account base within the context of the fiscal sales plan and multi-year regional strategy, and build the pipeline of accounts ready to graduate into the Pod model.


What We’re Seeking


  • Deep knowledge of complex selling environments in the B2B technology world and what it takes to build brand and product awareness and pipeline.
  • 10 to 15 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, with a demonstrated ability to operate at a strategic level and lead through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Proven experience running scaled, always-on campaign engines (email, digital, webinars, tradeshows) across a large, diverse account base, and converting broad interest into qualified, sales-ready pipeline.
  • B2B technology marketing experience spanning FICO's core industries (banking, telco, and related sectors) preferred; familiarity with the competitive and regulatory landscape across these spaces is a significant advantage.
  • Maturity and skill in collaborating with senior executives, customers, and sales teams to align on goals and work through business challenges.
  • Creative skills in both communications and problem solving.
  • Expertise in using metrics and marketing performance measurement to optimize results and ROI in a corporate marketing environment.
  • Strong experience using GenAI to develop demand generation and event content and personalize content to specific personas and accounts, and — ideally — broader experience exploring AI-driven approaches to pipeline generation beyond content creation (see above).
  • Outstanding writing and presentation skills.
  • A passion for technology, learning, and creativity.
  • Knowledge and experience building demand marketing plans, and a clear point of view on how campaign-based demand generation and Pod-based ABM should hand off to one another as accounts mature.
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in marketing or a related field.


Our Offer to You


  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers, and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits, and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $115,500 to $181,500 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

#LI-Remote


Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.


FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

  • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
description_html:
Lifecycle Marketing Specialist

North - Remote (US)


Let’s go North, together.

Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

The Lifecycle Marketing Specialist owns the customer journey from first touch through renewal and expansion. This role is responsible for designing and executing email, in-app, and multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that transition contacts through the funnel—from lead to activated customer to advocate. Acting as the primary owner of the marketing automation platform (HubSpot), this position operates at the intersection of demand generation, product marketing, and analytics, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver relevant, timely, and measurable customer experiences.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and optimize multi-channel lifecycle campaigns (email, in-app, SMS) across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, win-back, and expansion.
  • Own segmentation and lifecycle stage definitions in HubSpot, ensuring clean handoffs between marketing, sales, and customer success.
  • Build and maintain nurture tracks for MQLs, trials, and post-sale customers with clear conversion and engagement goals at each stage.
  • Partner with Analytics/Ops to define and track core lifecycle metrics (activation rate, time-to-value, retention, expansion revenue) and report on campaign performance.
  • Identify and troubleshoot data integrity issues across the lifecycle funnel (e.g., stage mismatches between HubSpot and CRM/Partner systems).
  • Run A/B tests on messaging, timing, and channel to continuously improve conversion rates at each lifecycle stage.
  • Collaborate with Content and Design teams to produce lifecycle-specific creative assets (email copy, in-app messages, triggered content).


What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or CRM marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.
  • Strong experience with HubSpot, including workflows, segmentation, and lifecycle stage management.
  • Track record of building nurture programs that measurably drive key business metrics (pipeline, activation, retention, NRR).
  • Experience in payments, fintech, or other regulated B2B industries is a plus.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently pull and interpret data to drive campaign decisions.
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Success teams on lifecycle and handoff processes.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with a capability to write compelling lifecycle copy or brief creators effectively.
  • High comfort with ambiguity and a builder’s mindset focused on creating infrastructure rather than just executing existing campaigns.
  • Nice to Have: Familiarity with SQL, BI tools (Looker, Tableau), product-led growth motions, and in-app messaging tools.


What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Education Assistance
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account


Salary Range: $60,980-$82,500

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.


Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.


Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.


Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.


At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.


To learn more about North, and our family of companies, visit our website: north.com

Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We're Looking For

As a Campaign Manager, Life Sciences, you will support the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns that drive engagement, demand, and pipeline growth across key healthcare audiences. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will play a critical role in bringing campaigns to life across channels and ensuring seamless execution across teams.
This role is ideal for a marketer with a strong foundation in campaign execution who is highly organized, data-driven, and eager to grow within B2B healthcare marketing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously
  • Experience supporting multi-channel marketing campaigns (email, digital, content, events, etc.)
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and generate insights
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Sales and Product

The Opportunity

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Demand Generation Director at Coupa:

The Demand Generation Director is accountable for the integrated demand strategy and its execution across the Americas. The position owns the regional demand process end to end, including demand planning, sales play and outreach cadence design, pipeline health, and lead-to-deal conversion, and sets the foundation for how demand is generated and progressed in the Americas.

The position is the primary point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and Revenue Operations for demand matters in the Americas. It chairs the regional Demand Board, holds the integrated demand plan, and is accountable for the pipeline health and conversion outcomes that result. This is an individual contributor position that operates through influence across the demand ecosystem rather than through direct authority.

What You'll Do:

Demand strategy and planning

  • Leads the regional demand process, including planning, coordination and analysis, and is accountable for the integrated demand plan for the Americas.
  • Develops integrated demand strategies that align marketing, sales and partner activity to regional pipeline and revenue objectives.
  • Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan.
  • Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it.

Demand execution and sales plays

  • Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement.
  • Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar.
  • Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process.
  • Accountable for adoption and performance of the sales plays and cadences released into the region, and for revision or retirement of those that do not perform.

Pipeline health and conversion

  • Accountable for a healthy and predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities for the regional sales organization, measured against defined coverage and quality standards.
  • Uses data and analytics to track the performance of demand generation initiatives, and identifies the drivers of variance between plan and actual.
  • Accountable for lead-to-deal conversion improvement in the Americas, including diagnosis of conversion loss by stage, source and segment, and the remediation plan.
  • Tracks performance and progress of demand activity against pipeline health metrics, and reports status on a defined cadence.

Cross-functional coordination and governance

  • Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and other functions to develop a coordinated and integrated demand plan that meets business goals.
  • Hosts the regional Demand Board and associated planning activities to track progress and align the demand ecosystem on priorities, commitments and outcomes.
  • Escalates to the Leader, Demand Orchestration where cross-functional commitments, resourcing or prioritization cannot be resolved in the Americas.
  • Fosters a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and excellence across the demand ecosystem, and drives improvement of the processes and tools the ecosystem depends upon.

Market insight and solution knowledge

  • Monitors and analyzes market trends, customer behaviors and the competitive landscape, and applies that analysis to demand planning and play design.
  • Maintains a working understanding of areas of strength and weakness across the relevant solution portfolio, and reflects that understanding in targeting and messaging priorities.
  • Partners with Product Marketing and Competitive Intelligence to keep demand activity current with positioning and competitive changes.

Insight to leadership

  • Provides proactive insight to leadership on demand planning, forecasting and execution, including risks to pipeline coverage and the actions required.
  • Represents the regional demand position in planning and review cycles, including quarterly business reviews and annual planning.
  • Translates demand performance into the commercial implications leadership requires for decision-making.

Performance Measures

  • Pipeline coverage and quality against regional targets, by segment and solution.
  • Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-close conversion rates against baselines.
  • Contribution of demand activity to qualified pipeline and closed revenue in the Americas.
  • Delivery of the demand plan against committed scope and calendar.
  • Adoption and performance of released sales plays and outreach cadences.
  • Demand Board and planning cadence operating as designed, with documented commitments and follow-through.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of demand reporting and insight to leadership.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Bachelor's degree in an analytical discipline such as Finance, Business, Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ten or more years of experience in business-to-business demand generation, demand management or a closely related go-to-market function.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing and implementing successful demand management strategies at scale.
  • Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience designing sales plays and outreach cadences, and measuring their performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and to build durable internal relationships, including with senior stakeholders, without direct authority.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, and demonstrated problem-solving capability, including the ability to translate process into value-adding business activity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability, including the ability to set direction, and to inspire and motivate teams the position does not manage.
  • Demonstrated commitment to challenging, improving and innovating at both a personal and an organizational level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in large technology companies, in a multi-segment, multi-region organization with an established partner channel.
  • Working knowledge of the platforms that support demand motions, including CRM, sales engagement and cadence management, prospecting and contact data, and intent or account-based marketing platforms.
  • Experience integrating partner and advisory motions into demand planning and execution.
  • Prior experience in a quota-carrying, sales management or field-facing role.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

description_html:
Job Summary

The Director of Digital Marketing helps translate Midwest Veterinary Supply’s Marketing strategy into an integrated digital demand and customer engagement capability. In partnership with the VP of Marketing, this role helps develop and execute digital plans that strengthen the digital customer experience, increase awareness and engagement, support lead generation and conversion, and contribute to business growth. The Director leads digital marketing channels and programs, including website and digital experience, SEO/SEM, paid digital media, email and marketing automation, social media management, and analytics. The role works closely with Marketing Services, Brand Engagement, Sales, ecommerce and technology partners to connect customer needs, content and campaigns across the buying journey and to use performance insights to continually improve results.


This is a remote position. description_html:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm's top-line growth through strategic partnerships, growth initiatives, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm's products.

Within the Revenue organization, Platform Growth Marketing acquires merchants through platforms and partners. We work with PSPs and ISVs to build joint go-to-market programs, activate partner ecosystems, and drive measurable pipeline, GMV, and revenue. As our partner portfolio grows, we're building reusable programs, assets, and measurement that help multiple partners go to market at once. The team works closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence.

About the Role

We're looking for a Platform Marketing Lead to develop and execute merchant acquisition and activation programs through Affirm's platform and ISV channels.

You'll identify the right marketing channels for each opportunity, build integrated campaigns, and use performance data to improve results. You'll work directly with platform partners and cross-functional Affirm teams to turn merchant insights and business goals into programs that drive acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, and revenue.

This is a hands-on role. You'll move between channel strategy, campaign development, partner collaboration, asset creation, execution, and measurement. Experience with platform or partner GTM is helpful, but we're primarily looking for a strong marketer who can learn a new ecosystem quickly.

What Success Looks Like
  • Launch integrated merchant acquisition and activation programs through priority platforms and ISVs.
  • Select the right channel mix based on the audience, objective, funnel stage, and available evidence.
  • Connect campaign activity to merchant acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, or revenue.
  • Identify where performance is breaking down and recommend what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Build messaging, campaign briefs, content, partner assets, and measurement plans.
  • Develop strong working relationships with platform partners and internal teams.
  • Turn successful campaigns into reusable playbooks, templates, and channel practices.

What You'll Do

  • Own channel strategy and execution for a defined set of platform marketing programs.
  • Develop integrated campaigns across owned, partner, lifecycle, events, sales-assisted, and paid channels as relevant.
  • Build campaign briefs, content, partner toolkits, presentations, and performance recaps.
  • Work with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence to move programs from idea to launch.
  • Define campaign objectives, funnel stages, KPIs, attribution assumptions, and reporting requirements.
  • Analyze performance and recommend where to invest, optimize, test, or stop.
  • Learn the business models, audiences, and operating styles of different platform partners.
  • Manage multiple programs while making clear priority and capacity tradeoffs.

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of experience in integrated, channel, growth, lifecycle, demand generation, or product marketing.
  • Experience selecting and managing multiple marketing channels against a defined business objective.
  • A track record of measuring acquisition, conversion, activation, pipeline, revenue, or comparable commercial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to make decisions when attribution or performance data is incomplete.
  • Hands-on experience building campaign briefs, messaging, content, presentations, or performance reports.
  • Strong project management across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Ability to learn new products, audiences, and business models quickly.
  • Clear recommendations, personal ownership, and willingness to handle execution details.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management.
Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

description_html:
A Note on How to Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.


About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.


Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.


What You’ll Do:

Demand generation strategy & execution

  • Own and execute the demand generation strategy for our government and public sector segment, plus other new segments, building lists, driving MQLs and creating pipeline that consistently meets or exceeds targets
  • Build and run integrated, multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, events, content) tailored to segment buyer behavior and budget cycles
  • Bring an inventive, test-and-learn approach, piloting new channels and tactics rather than relying solely on established playbooks

Account-based marketing

  • Lead ABM strategy and execution for targeted accounts, including account selection, personalization at scale, and close alignment with Sales on account engagement
  • Partner with Sales to define and refine target account lists across assigned segments including local and state government prospects

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work closely with Content, Product Marketing, and Sales to ensure messaging and campaigns resonate with buyer pain points
  • Partner with Events on segment-focused field and virtual events, from conference presence to webinars and roundtable lunch and learns
  • Align with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, channel metrics, and handoff to ensure marketing-sourced conversions

Metrics & reporting

  • Take a highly metrics-driven approach to pipeline generation, with fluency in attribution, funnel conversion, and pipeline efficiency reporting
  • Report regularly on segment performance against pipeline and revenue targets, adjusting strategy based on results
  • Other duties as assigned


What You’ll Need:
  • Proven track record leading demand generation through a period of rapid company growth, ideally including experience operating through M&A or platform/product integration
  • History of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
  • Strong command of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution
  • Experience marketing B2B SaaS into government buyers, particularly at the local and state level
  • Highly metrics-driven, with fluency in attribution and funnel/pipeline reporting
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from the ground up as a segment scales
  • Strong collaborator — experience working closely with Content, Product Marketing, Events, and Sales/RevOps to drive integrated demand generation
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to have

  • Experience in adjacent regulated or mission-driven verticals (nonprofit, education, public sector tech)
  • Experience with grant management or grantmaking software, or adjacent nonprofit tech
  • Experience in demand generation at a rapidly growing government focused B2B SaaS company
  • Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, budget cycles, and messaging tailored to government stakeholders at the local and state level particularly
  • Relationships within government and public sector networks and associations relevant to grantmaking


What You’ll Bring to our Team Dynamics:

Strategic Thinking

Translates Foundant's North Star into a concrete strategy for scaling into government, public sector, and other emerging segments — building the playbook, list, and pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one

Performance Advancement

Sets a high bar for pipeline and revenue performance in a brand-new segment, using attribution and funnel data to catch what's working — and what isn't — before quarterly targets are at risk

Decision-Making

Uses evidence and a test-and-learn approach to make fast, well-reasoned calls on new channels and tactics in a segment with no existing playbook to fall back on

Collaboration and Learning

Builds real working relationships across Content, Product Marketing, Events, Sales, and RevOps — because a segment this new only scales if the whole team is pulling in the same direction


Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!


Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.


Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact hr@smartsimple.com.

About Eleanor Health


Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.


About the Role


Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

Where we are

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

Where we are going

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

  • First — Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
  • Second — Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
  • Third — Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

The channels

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

How the funnel is shared

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

What this role is accountable for

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.


What You'll Do


Paid Media Strategy & Performance

  • Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
  • Own budget pacing and allocation across all five channels, shifting investment toward what is working
  • Lead paid channel diversification: build, test, and scale affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, with a defined budget, success criteria, and scale-or-stop decision for each
  • Be hands-on in the newer channels: build campaigns, manage partners and platforms, and optimize against member-level outcomes rather than platform-reported leads
  • Manage programmatic and streaming audio partners as an informed client, including planning, creative requirements, measurement, and incrementality
  • Direct the paid search specialist on Google and Microsoft: set priorities, review work, and stay close enough to the accounts to audit the work independently
  • Design and run structured tests of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max, with clear success criteria defined before launch
  • Plan for seasonality: demand and cost per click vary substantially by month in addiction treatment, and the annual plan should reflect that rather than assume a flat target
  • Maintain offline conversion tracking and value-based bidding wherever a channel supports it, so campaigns optimize toward members rather than leads
  • Ensure all paid activity meets LegitScript certification and platform policy requirements for addiction treatment advertising. Meta, Reddit, and programmatic partners each apply their own restrictions

Affiliate & Partner Channels

  • Build and manage the affiliate program: recruit and vet partners, set terms, track quality, and cut what does not produce members
  • Structure affiliate and partner compensation in partnership with Legal and Compliance, including EKRA and Anti-Kickback requirements
  • Hold every partner to member-level quality rather than lead volume, and to our advertising and privacy standards

Website Conversion & Experimentation

  • Own website-visitor-to-lead conversion as a primary accountability
  • Build and run a disciplined experimentation program: written hypotheses, pre-declared success measures, and documented readouts including the tests that lose
  • Prioritize the test roadmap by expected impact rather than by ease or preference
  • Own the online self-scheduling experience and the forms that lead into it
  • Partner with the content specialist and design partners on landing page builds and publishing
  • Partner with the Organic & AI Acquisition team on page changes that affect both conversion and discoverability

Funnel Performance & Measurement

  • Maintain a view of the funnel from first impression to submitted lead, and know at all times which step is weakest
  • Establish and maintain a conversion baseline for every step, with methodology agreed with our data and analytics consultant
  • Report cost per new member and member quality by channel, including channels where tracking is imperfect, and use incrementality tests where attribution alone cannot answer the question
  • Participate in the standing intake funnel review with Access and the lifecycle owner, bringing the paid and website perspective
  • Maintain clean attribution between paid and non-paid sources
  • Report performance monthly against target, and explain variance without being asked

Team & Vendor Management

  • Direct the paid search and paid media specialists: set expectations in writing, hold a consistent feedback cadence, and develop them deliberately
  • Manage affiliate networks, programmatic and audio partners, and other channel vendors as an informed client
  • Maintain a current quarterly plan for the function showing priorities, expected impact, owners, and timelines


You'll Be a Good Fit If You:
  • Are equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the work. This is a small team, and everyone on it executes
  • Have built a channel from zero: launched it, measured it honestly, and either scaled it or shut it down
  • Get genuinely excited by a half-point conversion lift, because you know what it compounds to across every channel
  • Think in terms of members rather than leads, and have turned down a cheap-lead tactic because you knew what happened downstream
  • Are comfortable where attribution is messy, as in affiliate, audio, and programmatic, and still hold every channel to member-level economics
  • Are curious about channels you have not run yet, and rigorous about how you test them
  • Work well inside a shared accountability, where the number depends on teams you do not manage and the only way through is a real working relationship
  • Are rigorous about testing: the hypothesis comes first, and the losses get reported
  • Find the constraints of regulated healthcare marketing energizing rather than frustrating
  • Can say what your team is not doing this quarter, and why
  • Approach the work with compassion, knowing that a faster, clearer path to care is sometimes the difference between someone entering treatment and giving up


Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience — roughly 5+ years in performance or acquisition marketing, with at least two managing a substantial paid media budget
  • Channel expertise — hands-on expertise in at least three of the five channels we run: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. Real depth in at least one of affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, or Reddit, and ideally two, is essential. Paid search is covered by a specialist, so strong search skills alone are not what we are hiring for
  • Channel building — a record of launching a paid channel from zero and scaling it on member-level or customer-level economics rather than platform-reported conversions
  • Paid search literacy — enough working knowledge of Google and Microsoft Ads to direct and audit a specialist
  • Conversion optimization — demonstrated experience running a structured experimentation program, not just making site changes
  • Measurement — comfort building and defending your own reporting, measuring to the end of the funnel rather than to the lead, and handling imperfect attribution in affiliate, audio, and programmatic. Familiarity with incrementality testing
  • Management — experience directing specialists, contractors, or vendors. Experience managing at least one direct report is a plus
  • Judgment — sound decision-making in a space with hard compliance constraints around patient privacy, partner compensation, and advertising policy
  • Operating rigor — can prioritize under constraint and hold a plan while conditions change


Helpful but not required:

  • Healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated-category marketing experience
  • LegitScript certification experience or familiarity with addiction treatment advertising policy
  • Experience running an affiliate program on a network or platform
  • Experience with a customer data platform or call tracking tooling
  • Experience working alongside a contact center or intake team on shared conversion targets
  • Multi-state or multi-market experience


What This Role Is Not:

We would rather be clear now than waste your time.

  • Not a paid search role. Google and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a specialist runs them. This role is hired to build the channels around them.
  • Not an organic, content, or brand role. Organic search, AI visibility, reputation, and brand sit with a peer function.
  • Not a lifecycle or CRM role. Lifecycle marketing and intake conversion sit with the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which owns the content behind them.
  • Not a purely strategic seat. There is real hands-on work here, and someone looking to direct rather than build would not enjoy it.
  • Not a role where you can hand the thinking to an agency. Partners and vendors execute; this role sets direction and owns the result.

Compensation & Benefits

The target compensation range for this position is $105,000-115,000. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage - We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).
  • Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.
  • Family Medical Leave - Eleanor Health’s Paid Family & Medical Leave (“PFML”) is designed to provide flexibility and financial peace of mind for approved family and medical reasons such as the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, and for serious health conditions that you or a family member/significant other might be facing.
  • Wellness Perks & Benefits - Mental Health is important to us and we want our employees to have the accessibility you deserve to talk things through, zen with a mindfulness app, or seek assistance from health advocates
    • Mindfulness App Reimbursement
    • EAP with eight face-to-face sessions
    • Virtual health and wellness visits covered by our medical plan.

Growth Marketing Manager

Location: Remote (United States)

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).
