title: Demand Generation Manager
description_html:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Marketing Generalist to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don't improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization's security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

The Demand Generation Manager will own the strategy, execution, measurement, and optimization of multichannel demand-generation programs. This role will be responsible for converting CyberSheath's market expertise into awareness, engagement, qualified demand, sales opportunities, and measurable pipeline contribution.

The ideal candidate combines B2B demand-generation expertise with strong campaign operations, content instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to collaborate closely with Sales, subject-matter experts, external partners, and marketing leadership. They are equally comfortable developing a quarterly campaign plan, writing campaign briefs, launching a webinar nurture sequence, analyzing funnel performance, and recommending changes based on data.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation Strategy

  • Develop and execute a scalable, full-funnel demand-generation strategy aligned to CyberSheath's revenue objectives, ideal customer profile, priority verticals, buyer personas, and sales motions.
  • Build integrated campaign plans that create awareness, capture demand, nurture prospects, accelerate opportunities, and support expansion or cross-sell opportunities.
  • Define targeted campaigns for key audiences, including DIB owners and executives, CISOs, CIOs, IT directors, compliance leaders, security practitioners, contracts leaders, and operations stakeholders.
  • Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear, buyer-centered messaging that emphasizes business outcomes, risk reduction, contract readiness, operational continuity, and long-term compliance readiness.
  • Establish campaign themes and content pillars around CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, CUI protection, compliance gaps, assessments, remediation, managed services, and secure federal enclave offerings.
  • Partner with executive leadership and subject-matter experts to identify timely market opportunities, regulatory developments, customer pain points, and thought-leadership angles.

Campaign Development and Execution

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize integrated campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, webinars, virtual events, field events, partner marketing, landing pages, content syndication, retargeting, and other relevant channels.
  • Build campaign journeys for prospects at different stages of maturity, from early awareness of CMMC requirements through active evaluation of compliance solutions.
  • Develop campaign briefs that define target audience, objective, message, offer, channels, assets, timeline, budget, success metrics, and follow-up requirements.
  • Coordinate the creation of campaign assets, including landing pages, email sequences, advertisements, webinar materials, reports, checklists, guides, case studies, customer stories, and sales enablement materials.
  • Manage campaign calendars and ensure programs launch on time, meet quality standards, and align with broader company priorities.
  • Run A/B tests across audiences, messaging, subject lines, offers, landing pages, calls to action, creative, and channels to improve conversion and efficiency.
  • Support event and webinar demand generation before, during, and after programs, including registration strategy, promotional plans, attendance conversion, follow-up nurture, and opportunity acceleration.

Lead Management and Lifecycle Marketing

  • Partner with Sales leadership to define and maintain lead-management processes, including lead stages, lead scoring, routing, qualification criteria, service-level expectations, and feedback loops.
  • Build and optimize nurture programs that educate prospects, establish CyberSheath's credibility, and move accounts toward sales engagement.
  • Segment audiences based on company profile, role, compliance maturity, engagement history, intent signals, customer lifecycle stage, and buyer behavior.
  • Ensure leads are routed accurately and promptly, and work with Sales to improve conversion from marketing-qualified lead through opportunity and closed revenue.
  • Develop targeted account-based marketing programs for strategic accounts, named-account lists, high-value verticals, and partner-led opportunities.
  • Help Sales teams engage buying committees with coordinated messaging and content tailored to business, technical, and compliance concerns.

Performance Measurement and Optimization

  • Own campaign reporting and provide clear, actionable insights on performance, including engagement, conversion, qualified leads, meetings, opportunities, pipeline, revenue influence, cost per lead, cost per opportunity, and return on marketing investment.
  • Monitor funnel health and identify friction points from first touch through opportunity creation and closed-won revenue.
  • Create regular performance reviews for marketing and revenue leadership, translating results into recommendations, priorities, and next actions.
  • Maintain disciplined campaign attribution and tracking practices in collaboration with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Marketing Operations.
  • Use data to reallocate budget, improve underperforming programs, prioritize high-converting channels, and inform future campaign strategy.
  • Establish benchmarks and operational standards for campaign performance, audience engagement, lead quality, and pipeline contribution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales to ensure campaigns support active pipeline goals, account priorities, field needs, and market feedback.
  • Partner with product, service delivery, customer success, and cybersecurity subject-matter experts to create technically accurate, commercially relevant programs.
  • Collaborate with content, creative, digital, operations, and external agency partners to deliver high-quality work efficiently.
  • Equip sales teams with campaign context, prospect insights, follow-up guidance, relevant content, and messaging that improves conversion.
  • Participate in regular revenue meetings to share campaign performance, market signals, lead-quality insights, and recommended actions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive B2B demand generation, growth marketing, field marketing, lifecycle marketing, or integrated campaign experience.
  • Demonstrated success building multichannel campaigns that produced measurable pipeline and revenue impact—not simply lead volume.
  • Experience marketing complex B2B technology, professional services, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, IT infrastructure, or regulated-industry solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of demand-generation fundamentals, including audience segmentation, buyer journeys, campaign orchestration, lead scoring, nurture strategy, conversion optimization, and attribution.
  • Experience using CRM and marketing-automation platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot/Account Engagement, or comparable systems.
  • Proficiency with marketing analytics, campaign reporting, spreadsheet analysis, and dashboarding tools.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts without sacrificing credibility.
  • Strong project-management skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • A practical, test-and-learn mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing cybersecurity, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, FedRAMP, government contracting, defense technology, or compliance services.
  • Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting ecosystem, controlled information requirements, or regulated manufacturing and engineering environments.
  • Experience marketing managed security services, security assessments, compliance consulting, cloud-based security solutions, or managed IT services.
  • Experience with account-based marketing platforms, intent-data providers, webinar platforms, paid media platforms, and sales-engagement tools.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, private-equity-backed, consulting, managed-services, or B2B technology environment.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, paid search, LinkedIn advertising, retargeting, content syndication, and conversion-rate optimization.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, vendors, or marketing technology partners.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Demand Generation Manager will develop a detailed understanding of CyberSheath's services, target customers, sales process, existing marketing programs, conversion data, and go-to-market priorities. They will establish clear reporting, identify quick-win campaign improvements, and launch or refine priority programs.

Over time, success in this role will include:

  • A predictable, measurable demand engine that contributes meaningful qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Improved marketing-to-sales alignment, lead quality, lead follow-up, and conversion rates.
  • High-performing campaigns that reach and engage DIB organizations with relevant, credible compliance guidance.
  • Better visibility into channel performance, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, and marketing ROI.
  • Scalable nurture and account-based programs that support long and complex cybersecurity buying cycles.
  • Stronger market awareness of CyberSheath as a trusted end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic execution: Connects company growth goals to focused, practical, measurable campaign plans.
  • Commercial mindset: Prioritizes pipeline quality, sales outcomes, and revenue impact over vanity metrics.
  • Technical curiosity: Learns complex cybersecurity and compliance concepts quickly and communicates them clearly.
  • Analytical rigor: Uses data to diagnose problems, make decisions, and improve results.
  • Customer empathy: Understands the pressures facing DIB organizations navigating cybersecurity requirements.
  • Collaboration: Builds trust with Sales, subject-matter experts, operations, and external partners.
  • Ownership: Moves work forward, solves problems proactively, and follows through on commitments.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a changing regulatory and cybersecurity market where urgency, education, and credibility matter.

Work Environment


  • Fully remote role, with limited travel to industry events and offsite meetings
  • Must be a U.S. citizen residing in the continental United States.

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

HIRING: MARKETING GURU & MULTI-VENTURE GROWTH LEADER

Senior Marketing Strategist / VP of Marketing / Fractional CMO

Location: 100% remote, U.S. or international

Compensation: hourly rate (please quote your rate)

Engagement: freelance, ongoing potential

Concord Pacific Corp. is developing and commercializing multiple entrepreneurial ventures across technology, logistics, construction innovation, and other emerging business opportunities. Current initiatives include SPRINTER, an innovative city-to-city delivery and logistics platform, and STEEL ONE, a construction-industry innovation venture, alongside additional projects.

  • Build brand awareness, customer acquisition, lead generation, and conversion programs across digital and traditional channels.
  • Direct paid advertising, SEO/SEM, social media, video campaigns, email/CRM, public relations, and strategic partnerships as appropriate.
  • Plan product launches, test marketing channels, define target audiences, establish budgets, and optimize performance using measurable KPIs.

B2B Marketing & Lead Generation

Client Marketing & Collateral Development

  • Develop client-specific marketing materials that support member acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Support development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that drive awareness, consideration, and engagement for One Pass.

  • Monitor campaign performance and provide recommendations for optimization.

  • Leverage data and insights to improve audience targeting, messaging, and marketing effectiveness.

  • Track key performance indicators and communicate results to stakeholders.

You think strategically but aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves and execute, balancing thoughtful planning with a bias for action and speed.   • Experience partnering across cross-functional teams to drive marketing initiatives and business results.

  • Familiarity with performance marketing, content marketing, and campaign analytics.

Location

Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type
Full-time independent contractor

About RevSpark Media
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

About the Role
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

Your First Focus
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

What You'll Do
Testing Strategy

  • Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
  • Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
  • Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
  • Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

Account Structure and Quality Standards

  • Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
  • Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
  • Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
  • Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

Strategic Direction

  • Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
  • Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
  • Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
  • Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

Performance Analysis

  • Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
  • Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
  • Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
  • Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

Client Support, As Needed

  • Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
  • Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

Why Work With Us

  • Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
  • Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
  • Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
  • Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
  • Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
  • A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
  • Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
  • Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
  • Strong written communication and documentation habits.

Nice to have

  • Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
  • Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
  • Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

Company: Blize Home Care.
Location: Hercules/Hybrid (as applicable).
Employment Type: Full-time/Part-term Contract position.
Blize Home Care is a U.S.-based home care company dedicated to providing families and clients with reliable, high-quality caregiving services. We support individuals in the comfort of their homes, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, hospitals, and independent living communities throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

Our caregivers are trained and certified, with ongoing monthly education led by a Registered Nurse. Our training focuses on elderly care, young adult care, dementia support, and the delivery of compassionate, dependable care.

At Blize Home Care, we are committed to helping clients maintain their comfort, dignity, safety, and quality of life.
Role Overview:
Blize Home Care is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist with a strong background in Search Engine Optimization (SEO) to lead and execute our digital growth strategy.

The ideal candidate understands how SEO, content marketing, website optimization, and paid digital advertising work together to increase online visibility, attract qualified leads, and drive business growth.

This role is an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking, creative content development, and data-driven decision-making. Experience in healthcare, home care, or other regulated industries is an advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

SEO Strategy and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, search engine rankings, and website conversions.
  • Conduct keyword research to identify relevant search terms and growth opportunities.
  • Perform technical SEO audits and implement improvements related to website structure, indexing, crawlability, page speed, and mobile usability.
  • Optimize website pages, metadata, internal links, and content for search engines and users.
  • Develop ethical link-building strategies to strengthen website authority.

Content Marketing:

  • Plan, write, edit, and optimize blog posts, service pages, landing pages, and other website content.
  • Develop content strategies aligned with customer needs, search intent, and business objectives.
  • Apply local SEO strategies to improve visibility for home care services throughout the Bay Area.
  • Ensure healthcare-related content is accurate, trustworthy, accessible, and appropriately reviewed.

Digital Advertising and Conversion Optimization:

  • Support and optimize paid campaigns, including Google Ads and social media advertising.
  • Improve landing pages, calls to action, and website user experiences to increase inquiries and conversions.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align marketing campaigns with business goals.

Analytics and Performance Reporting:

  • Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools.
  • Track key performance indicators, including organic traffic, keyword rankings, lead generation, and conversion rates.
  • Prepare regular performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.
  • Monitor search engine algorithm updates, industry trends, and emerging digital marketing practices.

Collaboration and Compliance:

  • Work with management, design, and relevant healthcare professionals to maintain consistent brand messaging.
  • Follow applicable healthcare advertising requirements and privacy guidelines.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve online visibility, brand awareness, and lead quality.

Requirements:
  • At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on SEO.
  • Demonstrated success improving organic traffic, search visibility, and website performance.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and link building.
  • Experience managing websites through WordPress or another content management system.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
  • Understanding of keyword research, local SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Excellent written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and measure results against business goals.
  • Experience in healthcare, home care, senior care, medtech, or another regulated industry is a plus.

What We Offer:
  • Opportunity to work with a growing healthcare technology company.
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Direct impact on brand growth and market visibility.

How to Apply:
Send your CV and portfolio (or examples of SEO results/projects) to hr@blizecare.com

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume/CV and a portfolio or examples of SEO projects and results to:
Email: hr@blizecare.com

Please include a summary of your SEO experience, the tools you have used, and examples of measurable results you have achieved.
We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates who are passionate about digital marketing and helping families connect with quality home care services.

Instrumental is growing, and we are looking for an SEO Specialist to help clients become more discoverable, measurable, and competitive across traditional and AI-powered search.

This is not a traditional marketing role. You will combine search strategy with hands-on technical implementation: auditing websites, improving organic visibility, configuring and validating analytics and conversion tracking, and helping clients understand how people find and engage with their businesses. You will also help clients adapt to AI-driven discovery through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), prompt tracking, and practical visibility measurement.

You will work closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities, make or coordinate improvements, and connect search performance to meaningful business outcomes. The work calls for curiosity, precision, sound judgment, and a willingness to explain technical topics in clear, useful language. Search is changing quickly; we value people who can experiment thoughtfully while keeping the fundamentals strong.

Who We Are

Instrumental is a digital sales and marketing agency based in Golden, Colorado and a proud Elite HubSpot Partner. We partner with growth-minded organizations to build scalable, data-driven marketing and revenue strategies within the HubSpot ecosystem.

We show up unapologetically on our own terms. We lead with authenticity, build real relationships, and deliver exceptional work. There is a bit of Western frontier energy in how we operate. We are self-made, trailblazing, and committed to doing things the right way.

We are not the loudest in the room, but we earn trust quickly. Whether partnering with a Fortune 500 company, a CMO, or a founder building something from scratch, we meet people where they are and lead with a human-first approach. We care deeply about the craft behind a well-built HubSpot solution and the artistry behind a well-told brand story.

Our work speaks for itself. We have earned more HubSpot Impact Awards than any other agency because we stay focused on what matters most, delivering meaningful results that drive real client success. At Instrumental, high standards and strong culture go hand in hand. We support each other, take ownership, and take pride in the impact we create together.

Who You Are

You show up as your authentic self, grounded, prepared, and ready to contribute.

You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and communicate proactively. You ask thoughtful questions, build trust easily, and look for ways to improve both your work and the team around you.

You adapt your approach to meet people where they are, whether working with founders or enterprise-level leaders, without losing your authenticity. You value both discipline and creativity, and you care about doing things the right way.

You are organized, reliable, and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of work. Most importantly, you care about your work, your team, and the impact you are making.

How We Think About AI

AI is part of how modern teams do great work.

At Instrumental, we expect a baseline of curiosity, initiative, and practical experimentation when it comes to AI. Our team members consistently look for ways to improve how work gets done, whether that means increasing velocity by reducing time to complete a task or elevating excellence by improving the quality, clarity, and usefulness of the outcome.

You do not need to be an expert, but you should be open to exploring and adopting new tools and ways of working. We see AI as a way to enhance thinking, not replace it, and as a key part of building a more intelligent, efficient, and high-performing team.

Job Responsibilities

SEO Strategy and Implementation

  • Audit websites and search performance to identify technical, on-page, content, local, and authority-building opportunities.
  • Conduct keyword, topic, intent, competitor, and search-results research; prioritize opportunities by relevance, business value, and likelihood of impact, not search volume alone.
  • Build practical SEO roadmaps and execute or coordinate prioritized work, including metadata and heading updates, internal linking, URL and canonical improvements, redirects, content optimization, and local search enhancements.
  • Investigate crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile experience, Core Web Vitals, image, and page-performance issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with web, development, and client teams.
  • Work with sitemaps, robots.txt, Google Search Console, HubSpot SEO tools, and site crawlers to help search engines discover and interpret important content.
  • Recommend and support structured data and schema implementation, including JSON-LD, where it helps clarify entities, services, locations, and answers.
  • Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, and domain changes by identifying search and measurement risks and validating key technical elements before and after release.

Analytics, Tracking, and Measurement

  • Set up, configure, audit, and troubleshoot measurement across Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, HubSpot, and related platforms.
  • Translate business goals into a clear measurement plan: define key events and conversions, document what they mean, and align reporting across organic, paid, referral, and other relevant channels.
  • Implement or coordinate tracking for forms, calls, booking or quote actions, cross-domain journeys, and other meaningful user interactions, based on the client’s systems and access permissions.
  • QA tags, triggers, events, forms, and conversion paths to confirm that tracking fires as intended, avoids duplicates, and captures the right actions. Investigate discrepancies between analytics, advertising platforms, and CRM records.
  • Maintain clear event maps, naming conventions, implementation notes, and change logs so teams can understand what is tracked and why.
  • Build or improve analytics views, dashboards, and reports; monitor data quality and explain measurement limitations, consent dependencies, and attribution caveats clearly.
  • Connect search visibility and website engagement to leads, lead quality, pipeline, or other agreed business outcomes, and use the findings to recommend next steps.

AI Search and Answer Engine Optimization

  • Develop and execute AEO strategies that help clients improve their chances of being understood, surfaced, and cited by AI-powered search and answer experiences.
  • Configure and maintain AI-search foundations in supported platforms, such as brand and business profiles, products and services, ideal customer profiles, and tracked prompts.
  • Research realistic audience questions and build prompt sets around client priorities, products, services, personas, and buyer intent.
  • Establish AI-search visibility baselines and monitor measures such as prompt coverage, brand mentions, share of voice, citation frequency, sentiment, and referral activity where the platform and data support them.
  • Identify content and technical gaps from AI-search findings; recommend useful improvements to page structure, direct-answer content, FAQs, entity information, citations, and structured data.
  • Explain the evolving capabilities and limitations of AI-search tools and metrics. Set responsible expectations, distinguish measurable evidence from directional signals, and avoid overstating attribution or results.
  • Educate clients and teammates on AEO tools, prompt selection, tracking, and practical workflows so they can participate in and sustain the work.

Performance, Reporting, and Optimization

  • Monitor organic search, website, and AI-search performance; investigate changes and separate actual demand or ranking shifts from tracking, site, or attribution issues.
  • Analyze rankings, impressions, clicks, landing-page engagement, conversions, lead quality, and other client-specific measures to identify what is working and what needs attention.
  • Produce clear, client-ready audits, roadmaps, dashboards, and performance updates that connect technical work and search activity to client goals.
  • Use data and testing to refine recommendations, prioritize work, and communicate what changed, what was learned, and what should happen next.
  • Partner with paid media specialists to align search intent, keyword insights, conversion definitions, and reporting across paid and organic programs. Support paid search analysis as needed without assuming sole ownership of paid campaign budgets or management.

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Growth Strategists, content, creative, web, development, paid media, and HubSpot teams to improve discovery, measurement, and conversion paths.
  • Present audits, strategies, and recommendations in a clear, constructive way; help clients understand tradeoffs, dependencies, owners, and next steps.
  • Request and verify required access, identify when work depends on client or platform administrators, and communicate blockers early.
  • Manage multiple client workstreams, document decisions and implementation status, and follow through on agreed deliverables.
  • Stay current on search engine updates, analytics and privacy changes, AI-search behavior, AEO practices, and relevant platform capabilities; share useful learnings with clients and teammates.

Relevant Competencies You'll Need for This Position

  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, technical SEO, search intent, keyword and topic research, on-page optimization, crawling, indexing, and site architecture.
  • Hands-on experience configuring or troubleshooting web analytics and tracking, especially GTM, GA4, conversion events, and form or call measurement.
  • Ability to turn a business objective into a practical tracking plan and validate that the resulting data is useful and trustworthy.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot analytics and SEO tools, CRM data, cross-domain measurement, and the relationship between website activity and lead or pipeline reporting.
  • Familiarity with AEO, AI-search visibility, tracked prompts, answer engines, LLMs, or a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in this emerging area.
  • Understanding of structured data and schema markup, including JSON-LD, and how technical and content signals can support search understanding.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose data discrepancies, explain limitations, and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong reporting skills, with the ability to communicate technical and performance information clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of paid search platforms such as Google Ads, including conversion measurement and the ability to collaborate with paid media owners.
  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, analysis, reporting, testing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining human judgment and quality control.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong collaboration, project management, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Proactive problem solver who identifies opportunities, flags risks, and recommends thoughtful solutions.
  • Adaptable and comfortable adjusting strategies as platforms, algorithms, AI tools, and client needs evolve.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging digital marketing and measurement trends.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in SEO, search marketing, web analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience auditing websites and translating findings into prioritized recommendations or implemented improvements.
  • Experience setting up, validating, or troubleshooting analytics and conversion tracking with tools such as GTM, GA4, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience analyzing digital marketing performance and translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience with SEO and/or analytics platforms; experience with AI-search or AEO tools is a plus.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Accident insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • 15 paid holidays plus generous PTO
  • Quarterly incentive plan
  • A close-knit, supportive team that genuinely cares about the work and each other

Ready to make search more discoverable, measurable, and useful to client growth?
We would love to meet you.

  • Prepare client deliverables from project kickoff documents to rolling reporting.

E-Commerce Manager – Job Description

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven E-Commerce Manager to manage and grow our Shopify store. The ideal candidate has strong Shopify backend experience, understands website conversion optimization, is comfortable using AI tools, and can manage Klaviyo email marketing campaigns.

The primary goal of this position is to increase online sales, improve conversion rates, and continuously optimize the customer shopping experience.

1. Shopify Website Management

  • Manage and maintain the Shopify website and backend.
  • Continuously improve website layout, design, navigation, and user experience.
  • Optimize product pages, descriptions, images, collections, and product displays to increase sales.
  • Ensure products are presented in a visually appealing and professional way.
  • Improve homepage, landing pages, and promotional sections.
  • Manage product launches, promotions, discounts, and website updates.
  • Ensure the website performs well on desktop and mobile devices.
  • Identify and resolve website issues, broken links, and checkout problems.

2. Conversion Rate Optimization & Sales Growth

  • Analyze website performance and identify opportunities to increase conversion rates.
  • Monitor key metrics, including conversion rate, average order value (AOV), revenue, traffic, and cart abandonment.
  • Use Shopify Analytics, Google Analytics (GA4), and other reporting tools.
  • Identify underperforming products and pages and recommend improvements.
  • Conduct A/B testing on product pages, landing pages, and website elements.
  • Improve upselling, cross-selling, product recommendations, and bundling strategies.
  • Optimize the customer journey from homepage to checkout.
  • Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.

3. Klaviyo Email & SMS Marketing

  • Manage Klaviyo automated flows.
  • Work closely with the graphic designer to create visually appealing, sales-driven emails.
  • Execute promotional campaigns, product launches, and seasonal sales.
  • Build and optimize automated email flows, including welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, and post-purchase emails.
  • Segment customer lists to improve targeting and campaign performance.
  • Monitor email performance, including open rates, click rates, conversion rates, and revenue generated.
  • Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, email designs, offers, and messaging.
  • Develop strategies to grow the email subscriber list and increase customer lifetime value.
  • Ensure email and SMS campaigns follow applicable marketing and privacy requirements.

4. AI Tools & Website Optimization

  • Have hands-on experience using AI tools to improve e-commerce performance.
  • Use AI to analyze website metrics, customer behavior, and sales trends.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates using AI-powered insights.
  • Use AI tools to improve product descriptions, SEO content, and marketing copy.
  • Research and implement useful Shopify AI apps and automation tools.
  • Stay updated on new AI technologies that can improve sales, efficiency, and customer experience.
  • Use AI to streamline repetitive tasks and improve marketing productivity.

5. Technical Stack Management

  • Experience with Rebuy, Recharge, Loyalty Lion, Gorgias and other Integrations
  • Oversight of these integrations, including regular meetings with account reps to ensure company’s set up is optimized

6. Creative & Marketing Coordination

  • Work closely with graphic designers to develop website banners, promotional graphics, and email campaigns.
  • Provide clear creative direction based on sales goals and performance data.
  • Coordinate website updates with new product launches and marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure consistent branding and a premium visual presentation across the website.
  • Review creative assets and recommend changes that could improve customer engagement and sales.
  • Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure advertising campaigns align with website landing pages and promotions.

7. SEO & Website Performance

  • Collaborate with google consultant to optimize product pages, collections, and website content for search engines.
  • Monitor website speed, mobile usability, and technical performance.
  • Manage Shopify apps and integrations to ensure they support website performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability and internal search results.

8. Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor website sales and performance daily.
  • Prepare weekly reports covering sales, conversion rates, traffic, and email marketing results.
  • Identify what is working, what is underperforming, and what needs improvement.
  • Recommend and implement actionable strategies to increase revenue.
  • Track results of website changes and marketing campaigns.
  • Take ownership of e-commerce performance and continuously look for growth opportunities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing and growing a Shopify e-commerce store.
  • Strong knowledge of Shopify backend, themes, apps, and analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo email marketing and automation.
  • Experience using AI tools for e-commerce, marketing, and data analysis.
  • Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Knowledge about Google Analytics 4 and performance reporting.
  • Knowledge of SEO, product merchandising, and online customer behavior.
  • Ability to work with graphic designers and coordinate creative projects.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to turn data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and focused on measurable sales results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with beauty, cosmetics, or professional beauty e-commerce brands.
  • Experience with Shopify Plus.
  • Familiarity with subscription programs, loyalty programs, and customer retention strategies.
  • Experience with landing page builders, heatmaps, and A/B testing tools.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid.
  • Experience coordinating with paid advertising teams to improve campaign conversions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Revenue Growth: Increasing Shopify store sales.
  • Conversion Rate: Improving the percentage of website visitors who purchase.
  • Average Order Value: Increasing the average customer purchase amount.
  • Email Revenue: Growing revenue generated through Klaviyo.
  • Customer Retention: Increasing repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
  • Website Performance: Improving speed, usability, and shopping experience.
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly testing and implementing changes that deliver measurable results.

Our expectation: This person should not simply maintain the website. They should actively analyze performance, identify opportunities, propose improvements, and take initiative to grow online sales.

This position is for full-time, salaried employment, but we are open to an independent contractor if applicant prefers.

Pay: Up to $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance

Work Location: Remote
